# Norwegian review — 414 strings

*Generated by `node tools/i18n_review.mjs` from `data/i18n/`. Edit the **Norsk** column and
run `node tools/i18n_review.mjs --apply` to write it back. Do not edit the key or the English:
`--apply` matches on the key and refuses the file if a row is malformed.*

**What to look for.** The catalogue has had key parity since slice 4.2 — every English string has
a Norwegian one — and that says nothing about whether the Norwegian is any good. 10 strings
are byte-identical to their English (they are on `test/i18n.test.js`'s `SAME_IN_BOTH` list with
a reason each); the rest were drafted and have never been read by a Norwegian speaker (A21).

The **Slice** column is the slice that first added the string. A batch from one slice usually
shares a voice, so they are worth reading together.

| `quest.after-the-wreckage.text` | First version | It is over, and it left a mess. Ruined ground stays ruined until somebody clears it — nothing will build there and nothing will grow there. Take the bulldozer through it and we start again. | Det er over, og det etterlot et rot. Ødelagt grunn blir liggende til noen rydder den — ingenting bygges der, og ingenting vokser der. | `quest.after-the-wreckage.title` | First version | After the wreckage | Etter ødeleggelsene |
| `quest.city-of-five-thousand.text` | First version | Five thousand people. At this size the things you got away with early stop being free — the traffic, the smoke, the districts nobody wants to live in. Fix them and it keeps growing. | Fem tusen mennesker. På denne størrelsen slutter det du slapp unna med tidlig å være gratis — trafikken, røyken, strøkene ingen vil bo i. Ordne opp, så vokser den videre. |
| `quest.city-of-five-thousand.title` | First version | Five thousand | Fem tusen |
| `quest.city-of-two-thousand.text` | First version | Two thousand residents. I looked it up: that is officially a city in three countries and a large village in one very stubborn one. | To tusen. Nå er det en by, og den har byens problemer. |
| `quest.city-of-two-thousand.title` | First version | A city, then | To tusen |
| `quest.first-jobs.text` | First version | Your neighbours are lovely and entirely unemployed. | `quest.first-jobs.title` | First version | Somewhere to work | Et sted å jobbe |
| `quest.first-park.text` | First version | A park costs almost nothing and every plot that can see it is worth more. | `quest.first-park.title` | First version | Somewhere to sit | Et sted å sitte |
| `quest.first-power.text` | First version | Houses are wonderfully stubborn about electricity. A plant, and wire to carry it — nobody moves in without both. | Ingen flytter inn i et mørkt hus. Bygg et kraftverk og trekk ledninger bort til der du regulerte. |
| `quest.first-power.title` | First version | Lights on | Skru på lyset |
| `quest.first-residents.text` | First version | Road, power, water, and somewhere to live. That is the whole recipe. Let us see who turns up. | Strøm, vann og en vei. Nå trenger vi bare at noen finner ut av det. Førti innbyggere, så er dette et sted. |
| `quest.first-residents.title` | First version | The first neighbours | De første som flytter inn |
| `quest.first-road.text` | First version | Right! Nobody has ever moved to a field. Lay some road and we will have somewhere to put the houses beside. | Sånn! Ingen har noen gang flyttet til et jorde. Legg litt vei, så har vi et sted å sette husene ved siden av. |
| `quest.first-road.title` | First version | Somewhere to drive | Et sted å kjøre |
| `quest.first-service.text` | First version | Houses catch fire and people help themselves to things. | `quest.first-service.title` | First version | Somebody has to answer | Noen må rykke ut |
| `quest.first-tax.text` | First version | Everything you build is paid for by the people who live here, at whatever rate you set. Seven in the hundred is where we start. | `quest.first-tax.title` | First version | The town's purse | Byens kasse |
| `quest.first-water.text` | First version | And water. I am told people are quite insistent about it. A pump, and pipe close enough to the houses to matter. | Strøm er halve saken. Ingen blir boende uten vann heller — en pumpe, og rør bort til husene. |
| `quest.first-water.title` | First version | Something to drink | Vann i springen |

| `quest.first-zone.title` | First version | Room for people | Plass til folk |

| `quest.keep-the-lights-on.text` | First version | A city that outgrows its power plant finds out about it all at once. Get well ahead of it. | Nettet strekker seg lenger enn kraftverket rekker. Bygg ut produksjonen før mørket kommer. |
| `quest.keep-the-lights-on.title` | First version | Keep the lights on | Hold lyset på |
| `quest.the-crime-wave.text` | First version | Three break-ins on the same street and the rest of the district has noticed. Crime follows empty pockets and thin policing, and it drags land value down with it. Get it back under control. | Tre innbrudd i samme gate, og resten av strøket har lagt merke til det. Kriminalitet følger tomme lommer og tynn politidekning, og den drar tomteverdien med seg ned. Få den under kontroll igjen. |
| `quest.the-crime-wave.title` | First version | A bad month for locks | En dårlig måned for låser |
| `quest.the-high-street.text` | First version | You backed the shops, so the shops are your problem now. Let us see a real commercial district. | Handel samler seg der folk allerede går. Gi den plass, så kommer den. |
| `quest.the-high-street.title` | First version | The high street | Gågata |
| `quest.the-works.text` | First version | You backed industry, and the foreman has not stopped smiling. He would like somewhere to put it all. | Industrien vil ha plass og vei, og den vil helst ha den et stykke unna soverommene. |
| `quest.the-works.title` | First version | The works | Industriområdet |
| `quest.town-of-five-hundred.text` | First version | Five hundred people. That is a town, not a hamlet. Somebody will want to name a roundabout after you. | Fem hundre innbyggere. Det er ikke lenger en landsby. |
| `quest.town-of-five-hundred.title` | First version | A proper town | Fem hundre |
| `quest.unclog-the-streets.text` | First version | Your roads are full. Not busy — full. More road, or somewhere nearer for people to work. | Gatene står. Folk kommer seg ikke på jobb, og de som gjør det bruker en time på det. |
| `quest.unclog-the-streets.title` | First version | Unclog the streets | Løs opp køene |

| `stat.crime` | First version | Crime | Kriminalitet |
| `stat.crime.about` | First version | How much goes missing. It follows low land value and thin police cover, and it drags land value down further. | Hvor mye som forsvinner. Den følger lav tomteverdi og tynn politidekning, og drar tomteverdien videre ned. |
| `stat.demandC` | First version | Shop demand | Etterspørsel etter handel |
| `stat.demandC.about` | First version | How much commerce wants to open here. It follows residents with money to spend. | Hvor mye handel som vil etablere seg her. Den følger innbyggere med penger å bruke. |
| `stat.demandI` | First version | Industry demand | Etterspørsel etter industri |
| `stat.demandI.about` | First version | How much industry wants to build here. It follows jobs the city cannot yet supply. | Hvor mye industri som vil bygge her. Den følger jobber byen ennå ikke kan tilby. |
| `stat.demandR` | First version | Housing demand | Boligetterspørsel |
| `stat.demandR.about` | First version | How badly people want to move in. High demand means zone more housing; negative means you have zoned more than anyone wants. | Hvor gjerne folk vil flytte inn. Høy etterspørsel betyr at du bør regulere flere boliger; negativ betyr at du har regulert mer enn noen vil ha. |
| `stat.jobs` | First version | Jobs | Arbeidsplasser |
| `stat.jobs.about` | First version | Places to work, from shops and industry. Fewer jobs than residents and people leave; far more and the shops stand empty. | Steder å jobbe, fra handel og industri. Færre jobber enn innbyggere, og folk flytter; altfor mange, og butikkene står tomme. |
| `stat.landValue` | First version | Land value | Tomteverdi |
| `stat.landValue.about` | First version | What the ground is worth, averaged over the city. Parks, water and quiet raise it; pollution and crime lower it. | Hva grunnen er verdt, i snitt for byen. Parker, vann og ro hever den; forurensning og kriminalitet senker den. |
| `stat.noHistory` | First version | This city has barely any history yet. The graphs fill in a month at a time. | Denne byen har nesten ingen historie ennå. Grafene fylles ut måned for måned. |
| `stat.pollution` | First version | Pollution | Forurensning |
| `stat.pollution.about` | First version | Dirty air over the developed part of the city. Industry and congested roads make it; parks and distance absorb it. | Skitten luft over den utbygde delen av byen. Industri og kø lager den; parker og avstand demper den. |
| `stat.population` | First version | Residents | Innbyggere |
| `stat.population.about` | First version | How many people live here. Homes fill only where there is power, water and a road. | Hvor mange som bor her. Boliger fylles bare der det er strøm, vann og vei. |
